data.interpretation_limit: A formula/dispatch precision witness, not all-format accuracy, physical kernel trace or evidence that the installed wheel equals a particular source commit.

data.scope: selected upstream functions only, float4x4 instantiation, safe math; not GGML matmul or engine timing

provenance.modifications: Function bodies unchanged. Copyright prefix added. Probe supplies its own matching block structs and caller, uses safe math, and is not the whole GGML backend.
provenance.upstream_execution_scope: Only these templated dequantizers instantiated in an isolated public MLX Metal client; no whole-engine speed or compatibility qualification

data.interpretation: Mismatch witnesses need per-expression analysis; do not generalize to all GGUF types or devices.

logical_memory_bytes.scope: logical target allocations, not physical traffic or hard memory bound

allocator_peak.scope: whole child including references, not per-arm peak

limitations: Layer0 and one prompt/seed trajectory only; no LoRA, request-image quality or other SKU qualification.
Same packed bytes do not imply bitwise identical dequantization or reduction.
Cache preparation and added residency are separate from warm latency.
No DRAM/bank-stall counters, instruction attribution or whole-GGML engine benchmark.
Initial original-BF16 discovery had a legacy FP16 boundary label, despite explicit original_source metadata and BF16 ABI assertions; later confirmation corrects the label.
Input/weights are immutable per child; cache is not a production cross-checkpoint/LoRA cache.
All variants, samples, warmups and programming-error attempts remain local; no raw model/media embedded.

fixture_provenance.source_encoding: original BF16 checkpoint and original BF16 forced-GPU activations, converted to FP16
fixture_provenance.original_reference_scope: compiled MLX BF16 full fused gate/up, SiLU*up, down replica; not full request parity
